scripts.dev: npm run setup && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w jk-eng-backend" "npm run dev -w jk-eng-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w jk-eng-backend && npm run build -w jk-eng-frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w jk-eng-backend" "npm run start -w jk-eng-frontend"
